# Bend Nyelvű Optimalizált Fájlok B200 GPU-hoz Modal.com-on

A Bend programozási nyelv és a HVM2 (Higher-order Virtual Machine 2) kombinációja rendkívül hatékony megoldást nyújt a B200 GPU masszívan párhuzamos képességeinek kihasználására. A Bend a Python és Haskell kifejezőerejét ötvözi automatikus párhuzamosítással, ami ideális az AI modell betanításhoz. Az NVIDIA Blackwell B200 architektúra 192GB HBM3e memóriával, 8 TB/s sávszélességgel és natív FP4/FP8 támogatással forradalmasítja a nagy nyelvi modellek betanítását.[1][2][3][4][5]

## Architektúra és Optimalizálási Stratégia

A B200 GPU képességeinek maximális kihasználása érdekében az alábbi stratégiákat implementáljuk:[6][7]

- **Δ-Nets alapú optimal parallel λ-reduction**: Az 2025 májusában publikált Δ-Nets modell megoldja az optimális párhuzamos lambda redukció problémáját, interaction net alapú rendszerrel[8][9]
- **FP4/FP8 mixed-precision training**: A Blackwell Tensor Core-ok FP4 támogatása 3× throughput növekedést ér el az FP8-hoz képest[10][7]
- **Asynchronous pipeline parallelism**: Az AsyncMesh framework inspirálta megközelítés a data és pipeline párhuzamosság között[11][12]
- **Fusion-aware gradient checkpointing**: Operator fusion-t figyelembe vevő checkpoint stratégia 12% throughput javulást és 1.75× nagyobb batch size-t biztosít[13][14]
- **HBM3e bandwidth optimization**: Multi-stack koordináció algoritmusok 4-8 HBM stack között, 5 TB/s aggregate bandwidth eléréséhez[15]

## 1. Delta-Nets Interaction Combinator Kernel

```bend
// delta_nets_kernel.bend
// Δ-Nets alapú optimális párhuzamos λ-redukció B200 GPU-hoz
// Publikáció: arXiv:2505.20314 (2025 május)
// Interaction nets rendszer replikátorokkal, törölőkkel és fan-okkal

type Agent = Fan{level: u32, ports: u32} | Eraser | Replicator{level: u32, delta: u32, aux_count: u32} | Wire

type Port = Principal{agent_id: u32, port_idx: u32} | Auxiliary{agent_id: u32, port_idx: u32, level_offset: u32}

type InteractionNet = INet{agents: Tree(Agent), connections: Tree((Port, Port)), free_ports: List(u32), reduction_count: u64}

def create_interaction_net(initial_size: u32) -> InteractionNet:
  return INet{
    agents: Node(Fan{level: 0, ports: 2}, Empty, Empty),
    connections: Empty,
    free_ports: List/range(0, initial_size),
    reduction_count: 0
  }

def allocate_agent(net: InteractionNet, agent: Agent) -> (InteractionNet, u32):
  match net.free_ports:
    case List/Cons:
      agent_id = net.free_ports.head
      new_agents = Tree/insert(net.agents, agent_id, agent)
      new_net = INet{
        agents: new_agents,
        connections: net.connections,
        free_ports: net.free_ports.tail,
        reduction_count: net.reduction_count
      }
      return (new_net, agent_id)
    case List/Nil:
      return (net, 0xFFFFFFFF)

def connect_ports(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  new_connections = Tree/insert(net.connections, compute_connection_key(port_a, port_b), (port_a, port_b))
  return INet{
    agents: net.agents,
    connections: new_connections,
    free_ports: net.free_ports,
    reduction_count: net.reduction_count
  }

def compute_connection_key(port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> u64:
  match (port_a, port_b):
    case (Principal, Principal):
      return (port_a.agent_id << 32) | port_b.agent_id
    case (Principal, Auxiliary):
      return (port_a.agent_id << 32) | (port_b.agent_id + port_b.port_idx)
    case (Auxiliary, Principal):
      return (port_a.agent_id << 32) | (port_b.agent_id + port_b.port_idx)
    case (Auxiliary, Auxiliary):
      return ((port_a.agent_id + port_a.port_idx) << 32) | (port_b.agent_id + port_b.port_idx)

def reduce_interaction(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  agent_a = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_a))
  agent_b = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))
  
  match (agent_a, agent_b):
    case (Fan, Fan):
      return reduce_fan_fan(net, port_a, port_b)
    case (Replicator, Replicator):
      return reduce_replicator_replicator(net, port_a, port_b)
    case (Eraser, Replicator):
      return reduce_eraser_replicator(net, port_a, port_b)
    case (Eraser, Fan):
      return reduce_eraser_fan(net, port_a, port_b)
    case (Fan, Replicator):
      return commute_fan_replicator(net, port_a, port_b)
    case _:
      return net

def reduce_fan_fan(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  net_freed = deallocate_agents(net, [get_agent_id(port_a), get_agent_id(port_b)])
  (net_wire1, wire1_id) = allocate_agent(net_freed, Wire)
  (net_wire2, wire2_id) = allocate_agent(net_wire1, Wire)
  
  conn_a = find_auxiliary_connection(net_wire2, port_a, 0)
  conn_b = find_auxiliary_connection(net_wire2, port_b, 0)
  
  net_connected = connect_ports(net_wire2, conn_a, conn_b)
  
  return INet{
    agents: net_connected.agents,
    connections: net_connected.connections,
    free_ports: net_connected.free_ports,
    reduction_count: net_connected.reduction_count + 1
  }

def reduce_replicator_replicator(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  rep_a = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_a))
  rep_b = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))
  
  match (rep_a, rep_b):
    case (Replicator, Replicator):
      level_diff = rep_b.level - rep_a.level
      delta_constraint = level_diff <= rep_a.delta
      
      bend valid = delta_constraint:
        when True:
          net_freed = deallocate_agents(net, [get_agent_id(port_a), get_agent_id(port_b)])
          
          aux_pairs = List/range(0, min(rep_a.aux_count, rep_b.aux_count))
          
          fold net_wired = net_freed with idx in aux_pairs:
            (net_tmp, wire_id) = allocate_agent(net_wired, Wire)
            conn_a = find_auxiliary_connection(net_tmp, port_a, idx)
            conn_b = find_auxiliary_connection(net_tmp, port_b, idx)
            connect_ports(net_tmp, conn_a, conn_b)
          
          return INet{
            agents: net_wired.agents,
            connections: net_wired.connections,
            free_ports: net_wired.free_ports,
            reduction_count: net_wired.reduction_count + 1
          }
        when False:
          return net
    case _:
      return net

def reduce_eraser_replicator(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  rep = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))
  
  match rep:
    case Replicator:
      net_freed = deallocate_agents(net, [get_agent_id(port_a), get_agent_id(port_b)])
      
      aux_indices = List/range(0, rep.aux_count)
      
      fold net_erased = net_freed with idx in aux_indices:
        (net_tmp, eraser_id) = allocate_agent(net_erased, Eraser)
        conn = find_auxiliary_connection(net_tmp, port_b, idx)
        connect_ports(net_tmp, Principal{agent_id: eraser_id, port_idx: 0}, conn)
      
      return INet{
        agents: net_erased.agents,
        connections: net_erased.connections,
        free_ports: net_erased.free_ports,
        reduction_count: net_erased.reduction_count + 1
      }
    case _:
      return net

def reduce_eraser_fan(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  fan = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))
  
  match fan:
    case Fan:
      net_freed = deallocate_agents(net, [get_agent_id(port_a), get_agent_id(port_b)])
      
      (net_e1, eraser1_id) = allocate_agent(net_freed, Eraser)
      (net_e2, eraser2_id) = allocate_agent(net_e1, Eraser)
      
      conn_aux0 = find_auxiliary_connection(net_e2, port_b, 0)
      conn_aux1 = find_auxiliary_connection(net_e2, port_b, 1)
      
      net_c1 = connect_ports(net_e2, Principal{agent_id: eraser1_id, port_idx: 0}, conn_aux0)
      net_c2 = connect_ports(net_c1, Principal{agent_id: eraser2_id, port_idx: 0}, conn_aux1)
      
      return INet{
        agents: net_c2.agents,
        connections: net_c2.connections,
        free_ports: net_c2.free_ports,
        reduction_count: net_c2.reduction_count + 1
      }
    case _:
      return net

def commute_fan_replicator(net: InteractionNet, port_a: Port, port_b: Port) -> InteractionNet:
  fan = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_a))
  rep = Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))
  
  match (fan, rep):
    case (Fan, Replicator):
      net_freed = deallocate_agents(net, [get_agent_id(port_a), get_agent_id(port_b)])
      
      (net_r1, rep1_id) = allocate_agent(net_freed, Replicator{level: rep.level, delta: rep.delta, aux_count: rep.aux_count})
      (net_r2, rep2_id) = allocate_agent(net_r1, Replicator{level: rep.level, delta: rep.delta, aux_count: rep.aux_count})
      (net_f1, fan1_id) = allocate_agent(net_r2, Fan{level: fan.level + 1, ports: 2})
      (net_f2, fan2_id) = allocate_agent(net_f1, Fan{level: fan.level + 1, ports: 2})
      
      conn_fan_aux0 = find_auxiliary_connection(net_f2, port_a, 0)
      conn_fan_aux1 = find_auxiliary_connection(net_f2, port_a, 1)
      
      net_conn1 = connect_ports(net_f2, Principal{agent_id: fan1_id, port_idx: 0}, conn_fan_aux0)
      net_conn2 = connect_ports(net_conn1, Principal{agent_id: fan2_id, port_idx: 0}, conn_fan_aux1)
      
      aux_range = List/range(0, rep.aux_count)
      
      fold net_aux_wired = net_conn2 with idx in aux_range:
        (net_fan_aux, fan_aux_id) = allocate_agent(net_aux_wired, Fan{level: fan.level, ports: 2})
        
        rep_conn = find_auxiliary_connection(net_fan_aux, port_b, idx)
        
        net_tmp1 = connect_ports(net_fan_aux, Principal{agent_id: fan_aux_id, port_idx: 0}, rep_conn)
        net_tmp2 = connect_ports(net_tmp1, Auxiliary{agent_id: rep1_id, port_idx: idx, level_offset: 0}, Auxiliary{agent_id: fan_aux_id, port_idx: 0, level_offset: 0})
        connect_ports(net_tmp2, Auxiliary{agent_id: rep2_id, port_idx: idx, level_offset: 0}, Auxiliary{agent_id: fan_aux_id, port_idx: 1, level_offset: 0})
      
      net_final_conn1 = connect_ports(net_aux_wired, Principal{agent_id: rep1_id, port_idx: 0}, Auxiliary{agent_id: fan1_id, port_idx: 0, level_offset: 0})
      net_final_conn2 = connect_ports(net_final_conn1, Principal{agent_id: rep2_id, port_idx: 0}, Auxiliary{agent_id: fan2_id, port_idx: 0, level_offset: 0})
      
      return INet{
        agents: net_final_conn2.agents,
        connections: net_final_conn2.connections,
        free_ports: net_final_conn2.free_ports,
        reduction_count: net_final_conn2.reduction_count + 1
      }
    case _:
      return net

def deallocate_agents(net: InteractionNet, agent_ids: List(u32)) -> InteractionNet:
  fold net_freed = net with id in agent_ids:
    new_agents = Tree/remove(net_freed.agents, id)
    new_free_ports = List/Cons(id, net_freed.free_ports)
    INet{
      agents: new_agents,
      connections: net_freed.connections,
      free_ports: new_free_ports,
      reduction_count: net_freed.reduction_count
    }
  return net_freed

def find_auxiliary_connection(net: InteractionNet, port: Port, aux_idx: u32) -> Port:
  return Auxiliary{agent_id: get_agent_id(port), port_idx: aux_idx, level_offset: 0}

def get_agent_id(port: Port) -> u32:
  match port:
    case Principal:
      return port.agent_id
    case Auxiliary:
      return port.agent_id

def parallel_reduce(net: InteractionNet, max_iterations: u32) -> InteractionNet:
  active_pairs = collect_active_pairs(net)
  
  bend iteration = 0:
    when iteration < max_iterations:
      bend pair in active_pairs:
        fork:
          reduced_net = reduce_interaction(net, pair.0, pair.1)
          return reduced_net
      
      new_active_pairs = collect_active_pairs(net)
      
      if List/length(new_active_pairs) == 0:
        return net
      else:
        continue with iteration + 1
    when iteration >= max_iterations:
      return net

def collect_active_pairs(net: InteractionNet) -> List((Port, Port)):
  Tree/fold(net.connections, List/Nil, lambda acc, key, (port_a, port_b):
    match (Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_a)), Tree/lookup(net.agents, get_agent_id(port_b))):
      case (Some, Some):
        List/Cons((port_a, port_b), acc)
      case _:
        acc
  )

def min(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32:
  if a < b:
    return a
  else:
    return b

def lambda_to_inet(expr: LambdaExpr) -> InteractionNet:
  net = create_interaction_net(1024)
  
  match expr:
    case Var:
      return net
    case Abs:
      (net_fan, fan_id) = allocate_agent(net, Fan{level: 0, ports: 2})
      body_net = lambda_to_inet_recursive(net_fan, expr.body, fan_id, 0)
      return body_net
    case App:
      net_func = lambda_to_inet(expr.func)
      net_arg = lambda_to_inet(expr.arg)
      return merge_nets(net_func, net_arg)

def lambda_to_inet_recursive(net: InteractionNet, expr: LambdaExpr, parent_id: u32, aux_idx: u32) -> InteractionNet:
  match expr:
    case Var:
      return net
    case Abs:
      (net_fan, fan_id) = allocate_agent(net, Fan{level: aux_idx, ports: 2})
      parent_port = Auxiliary{agent_id: parent_id, port_idx: aux_idx, level_offset: 0}
      fan_port = Principal{agent_id: fan_id, port_idx: 0}
      net_connected = connect_ports(net_fan, parent_port, fan_port)
      return lambda_to_inet_recursive(net_connected, expr.body, fan_id, 0)
    case App:
      (net_fan, fan_id) = allocate_agent(net, Fan{level: aux_idx, ports: 2})
      net_func = lambda_to_inet_recursive(net_fan, expr.func, fan_id, 0)
      net_arg = lambda_to_inet_recursive(net_func, expr.arg, fan_id, 1)
      return net_arg

def merge_nets(net_a: InteractionNet, net_b: InteractionNet) -> InteractionNet:
  return INet{
    agents: Tree/merge(net_a.agents, net_b.agents),
    connections: Tree/merge(net_a.connections, net_b.connections),
    free_ports: List/concat(net_a.free_ports, net_b.free_ports),
    reduction_count: net_a.reduction_count + net_b.reduction_count
  }

type LambdaExpr = Var{name: u32} | Abs{param: u32, body: LambdaExpr} | App{func: LambdaExpr, arg: LambdaExpr}

def benchmark_parallel_reduction(net_size: u32, reduction_steps: u32) -> u64:
  initial_net = create_large_test_net(net_size)
  final_net = parallel_reduce(initial_net, reduction_steps)
  return final_net.reduction_count

def create_large_test_net(size: u32) -> InteractionNet:
  net = create_interaction_net(size * 4)
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < size:
      (net_rep, rep_id) = allocate_agent(net, Replicator{level: i % 8, delta: 2, aux_count: 4})
      (net_fan, fan_id) = allocate_agent(net_rep, Fan{level: i % 4, ports: 2})
      
      net_conn = connect_ports(net_fan, Principal{agent_id: rep_id, port_idx: 0}, Principal{agent_id: fan_id, port_idx: 0})
      
      continue with i + 1, net_conn
    when i >= size:
      return net

def main:
  test_net = create_interaction_net(256)
  
  (net1, fan1) = allocate_agent(test_net, Fan{level: 0, ports: 2})
  (net2, fan2) = allocate_agent(net1, Fan{level: 0, ports: 2})
  (net3, rep1) = allocate_agent(net2, Replicator{level: 1, delta: 3, aux_count: 3})
  
  net4 = connect_ports(net3, Principal{agent_id: fan1, port_idx: 0}, Principal{agent_id: fan2, port_idx: 0})
  
  reduced_net = parallel_reduce(net4, 1000)
  
  benchmark_result = benchmark_parallel_reduction(512, 2000)
  
  return reduced_net.reduction_count + benchmark_result
```

## 2. FP4 Mixed-Precision Training Optimizer

```bend
// fp4_mixed_precision_optimizer.bend
// FP4/FP8 mixed-precision training Blackwell B200 GPU-hoz
// Inspiráció: Quartet paper (arXiv:2505.14669v4)
// MXFP4 formátum használata optimal accuracy-vs-computation tradeoff-hoz

type FP4 = MXFP4{mantissa: u4, exponent: u4, shared_exp: u8, block_size: u32}

type FP8 = E4M3{mantissa: u8, exponent: u8} | E5M2{mantissa: u8, exponent: u8}

type Precision = FP4Prec{val: FP4} | FP8Prec{val: FP8} | FP16Prec{val: f32} | BF16Prec{val: f32}

type Tensor4D = T4D{data: Tree(Precision), shape: (u32, u32, u32, u32), precision_mode: PrecisionMode, block_config: BlockConfig}

type PrecisionMode = FullFP4 | MixedFP4FP8 | MixedFP4FP16 | AdaptiveMixed

type BlockConfig = BlockCfg{block_rows: u32, block_cols: u32, shared_exp_bits: u32, quantile_clipping: f32}

type GradientState = GradState{
  gradients: Tensor4D,
  momentum: Tensor4D,
  velocity: Tensor4D,
  iteration: u64,
  scaling_factor: f32
}

type OptimizerConfig = OptCfg{
  learning_rate: f32,
  beta1: f32,
  beta2: f32,
  epsilon: f32,
  weight_decay: f32,
  gradient_clipping: f32,
  fp4_threshold: f32,
  warmup_steps: u32,
  total_steps: u32
}

def create_tensor_fp4(batch: u32, seq_len: u32, hidden: u32, heads: u32, block_size: u32) -> Tensor4D:
  total_elements = batch * seq_len * hidden * heads
  block_count = (total_elements + block_size - 1) / block_size
  
  initial_data = Tree/from_list(List/replicate(total_elements, FP4Prec{val: MXFP4{mantissa: 0, exponent: 0, shared_exp: 127, block_size: block_size}}))
  
  return T4D{
    data: initial_data,
    shape: (batch, seq_len, hidden, heads),
    precision_mode: FullFP4,
    block_config: BlockCfg{block_rows: 32, block_cols: 32, shared_exp_bits: 8, quantile_clipping: 0.99}
  }

def fp4_quantize_block(values: List(f32), block_config: BlockConfig) -> List(FP4):
  sorted_abs = List/sort(List/map(values, lambda x: abs(x)))
  quantile_idx = (List/length(sorted_abs) * block_config.quantile_clipping) as u32
  clip_threshold = List/get(sorted_abs, quantile_idx)
  
  clipped_values = List/map(values, lambda x: clamp(x, -clip_threshold, clip_threshold))
  
  max_abs = List/fold(clipped_values, 0.0, lambda acc, x: max(acc, abs(x)))
  
  shared_exponent = compute_shared_exponent(max_abs, block_config.shared_exp_bits)
  
  scale = pow(2.0, (shared_exponent - 127) as f32)
  
  quantized = List/map(clipped_values, lambda x:
    quantize_to_fp4(x, scale, shared_exponent, block_config.block_rows * block_config.block_cols)
  )
  
  return quantized

def quantize_to_fp4(value: f32, scale: f32, shared_exp: u8, block_size: u32) -> FP4:
  normalized = value / scale
  
  mantissa_float = normalized * 8.0
  mantissa = clamp((mantissa_float as u32), 0, 15) as u4
  
  local_exp = compute_local_exponent(value)
  
  return MXFP4{mantissa: mantissa, exponent: local_exp, shared_exp: shared_exp, block_size: block_size}

def compute_shared_exponent(max_val: f32, exp_bits: u32) -> u8:
  if max_val == 0.0:
    return 127
  else:
    log_val = log2(max_val)
    biased_exp = (log_val + 127.0) as u8
    return clamp(biased_exp, 0, 255)

def compute_local_exponent(value: f32) -> u4:
  if value == 0.0:
    return 0
  else:
    log_val = log2(abs(value))
    exp = (log_val + 7.0) as u32
    return clamp(exp, 0, 15) as u4

def fp4_dequantize(fp4: FP4) -> f32:
  shared_scale = pow(2.0, (fp4.shared_exp - 127) as f32)
  local_scale = pow(2.0, (fp4.exponent - 7) as f32)
  
  mantissa_val = (fp4.mantissa as f32) / 8.0
  
  return mantissa_val * local_scale * shared_scale

def fp8_quantize_e4m3(value: f32) -> FP8:
  if value == 0.0:
    return E4M3{mantissa: 0, exponent: 0}
  
  abs_val = abs(value)
  log_val = log2(abs_val)
  
  exponent = clamp((log_val + 7.0) as u32, 0, 15) as u8
  
  normalized = abs_val / pow(2.0, (exponent - 7) as f32)
  mantissa = clamp((normalized * 8.0) as u32, 0, 7) as u8
  
  sign_bit = if value < 0.0: 128 else: 0
  
  return E4M3{mantissa: mantissa | sign_bit, exponent: exponent}

def fp8_dequantize_e4m3(fp8: FP8) -> f32:
  match fp8:
    case E4M3:
      sign = if (fp8.mantissa & 128) != 0: -1.0 else: 1.0
      mantissa_val = ((fp8.mantissa & 127) as f32) / 8.0
      exponent_val = pow(2.0, (fp8.exponent - 7) as f32)
      return sign * mantissa_val * exponent_val
    case E5M2:
      sign = if (fp8.mantissa & 128) != 0: -1.0 else: 1.0
      mantissa_val = ((fp8.mantissa & 127) as f32) / 4.0
      exponent_val = pow(2.0, (fp8.exponent - 15) as f32)
      return sign * mantissa_val * exponent_val

def matmul_fp4_tensor(tensor_a: Tensor4D, tensor_b: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch_a, seq_a, hidden_a, heads_a) = tensor_a.shape
  (batch_b, seq_b, hidden_b, heads_b) = tensor_b.shape
  
  result_shape = (batch_a, seq_a, hidden_b, heads_a)
  result_size = batch_a * seq_a * hidden_b * heads_a
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < result_size:
      row_idx = i / hidden_b
      col_idx = i % hidden_b
      
      fork:
        dot_product = compute_dot_product_fp4(tensor_a, tensor_b, row_idx, col_idx, hidden_a)
        
        quantized_result = fp4_quantize_value(dot_product, tensor_a.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized_result}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= result_size:
      result_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: result_data,
        shape: result_shape,
        precision_mode: FullFP4,
        block_config: tensor_a.block_config
      }

def compute_dot_product_fp4(tensor_a: Tensor4D, tensor_b: Tensor4D, row: u32, col: u32, dim: u32) -> f32:
  bend k = 0:
    when k < dim:
      idx_a = row * dim + k
      idx_b = k * (tensor_b.shape.2) + col
      
      val_a = get_tensor_element(tensor_a, idx_a)
      val_b = get_tensor_element(tensor_b, idx_b)
      
      fork:
        deq_a = dequantize_precision(val_a)
        deq_b = dequantize_precision(val_b)
        product = deq_a * deq_b
        
        return product
      
      continue with k + 1, accumulator + product
    when k >= dim:
      return accumulator

def get_tensor_element(tensor: Tensor4D, linear_idx: u32) -> Precision:
  Tree/lookup(tensor.data, linear_idx)

def dequantize_precision(prec: Precision) -> f32:
  match prec:
    case FP4Prec:
      return fp4_dequantize(prec.val)
    case FP8Prec:
      return fp8_dequantize_e4m3(prec.val)
    case FP16Prec:
      return prec.val
    case BF16Prec:
      return prec.val

def fp4_quantize_value(value: f32, config: BlockConfig) -> FP4:
  shared_exp = compute_shared_exponent(abs(value), config.shared_exp_bits)
  scale = pow(2.0, (shared_exp - 127) as f32)
  return quantize_to_fp4(value, scale, shared_exp, config.block_rows * config.block_cols)

def adaptive_precision_select(gradient_magnitude: f32, config: OptimizerConfig, iteration: u64) -> PrecisionMode:
  warmup_ratio = (iteration as f32) / (config.warmup_steps as f32)
  
  if warmup_ratio < 0.1:
    return MixedFP4FP16
  else:
    if gradient_magnitude > config.fp4_threshold:
      return MixedFP4FP8
    else:
      return FullFP4

def initialize_gradient_state(param_shape: (u32, u32, u32, u32), block_size: u32) -> GradientState:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = param_shape
  
  zero_tensor = create_tensor_fp4(batch, seq, hidden, heads, block_size)
  
  return GradState{
    gradients: zero_tensor,
    momentum: zero_tensor,
    velocity: zero_tensor,
    iteration: 0,
    scaling_factor: 1.0
  }

def quartet_optimizer_step(
  params: Tensor4D,
  gradients: Tensor4D,
  state: GradientState,
  config: OptimizerConfig
) -> (Tensor4D, GradientState):
  
  grad_magnitude = compute_tensor_norm(gradients)
  
  precision_mode = adaptive_precision_select(grad_magnitude, config, state.iteration)
  
  clipped_grads = gradient_clip(gradients, config.gradient_clipping)
  
  new_momentum = update_momentum_fp4(state.momentum, clipped_grads, config.beta1)
  
  new_velocity = update_velocity_fp4(state.velocity, clipped_grads, config.beta2)
  
  bias_corrected_m = bias_correction(new_momentum, config.beta1, state.iteration + 1)
  bias_corrected_v = bias_correction(new_velocity, config.beta2, state.iteration + 1)
  
  lr_schedule = cosine_annealing_lr(config.learning_rate, state.iteration, config.warmup_steps, config.total_steps)
  
  update_tensor = compute_adam_update(bias_corrected_m, bias_corrected_v, lr_schedule, config.epsilon, config.weight_decay)
  
  new_params = tensor_subtract_fp4(params, update_tensor)
  
  new_state = GradState{
    gradients: clipped_grads,
    momentum: new_momentum,
    velocity: new_velocity,
    iteration: state.iteration + 1,
    scaling_factor: compute_dynamic_scaling(grad_magnitude)
  }
  
  return (new_params, new_state)

def compute_tensor_norm(tensor: Tensor4D) -> f32:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem = get_tensor_element(tensor, i)
      deq_val = dequantize_precision(elem)
      
      fork:
        squared = deq_val * deq_val
        return squared
      
      continue with i + 1, accumulator + squared
    when i >= total_size:
      return sqrt(accumulator)

def gradient_clip(gradients: Tensor4D, max_norm: f32) -> Tensor4D:
  current_norm = compute_tensor_norm(gradients)
  
  if current_norm > max_norm:
    scale_factor = max_norm / current_norm
    return tensor_scale_fp4(gradients, scale_factor)
  else:
    return gradients

def update_momentum_fp4(momentum: Tensor4D, gradients: Tensor4D, beta: f32) -> Tensor4D:
  scaled_momentum = tensor_scale_fp4(momentum, beta)
  scaled_gradients = tensor_scale_fp4(gradients, 1.0 - beta)
  return tensor_add_fp4(scaled_momentum, scaled_gradients)

def update_velocity_fp4(velocity: Tensor4D, gradients: Tensor4D, beta: f32) -> Tensor4D:
  scaled_velocity = tensor_scale_fp4(velocity, beta)
  squared_gradients = tensor_elementwise_multiply_fp4(gradients, gradients)
  scaled_squared = tensor_scale_fp4(squared_gradients, 1.0 - beta)
  return tensor_add_fp4(scaled_velocity, scaled_squared)

def bias_correction(tensor: Tensor4D, beta: f32, iteration: u64) -> Tensor4D:
  correction_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 - pow(beta, iteration as f32))
  return tensor_scale_fp4(tensor, correction_factor)

def cosine_annealing_lr(base_lr: f32, iteration: u64, warmup: u32, total: u32) -> f32:
  if iteration < warmup:
    return base_lr * ((iteration as f32) / (warmup as f32))
  else:
    progress = ((iteration - warmup) as f32) / ((total - warmup) as f32)
    cosine_decay = 0.5 * (1.0 + cos(3.14159265359 * progress))
    return base_lr * cosine_decay

def compute_adam_update(momentum: Tensor4D, velocity: Tensor4D, lr: f32, epsilon: f32, weight_decay: f32) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = momentum.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      m_elem = get_tensor_element(momentum, i)
      v_elem = get_tensor_element(velocity, i)
      
      fork:
        m_val = dequantize_precision(m_elem)
        v_val = dequantize_precision(v_elem)
        
        update_val = lr * m_val / (sqrt(v_val) + epsilon)
        
        quantized_update = fp4_quantize_value(update_val, momentum.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized_update}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      update_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: update_data,
        shape: momentum.shape,
        precision_mode: momentum.precision_mode,
        block_config: momentum.block_config
      }

def tensor_scale_fp4(tensor: Tensor4D, scale: f32) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem = get_tensor_element(tensor, i)
      
      fork:
        deq_val = dequantize_precision(elem)
        scaled_val = deq_val * scale
        quantized = fp4_quantize_value(scaled_val, tensor.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      scaled_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: scaled_data,
        shape: tensor.shape,
        precision_mode: tensor.precision_mode,
        block_config: tensor.block_config
      }

def tensor_add_fp4(tensor_a: Tensor4D, tensor_b: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor_a.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem_a = get_tensor_element(tensor_a, i)
      elem_b = get_tensor_element(tensor_b, i)
      
      fork:
        val_a = dequantize_precision(elem_a)
        val_b = dequantize_precision(elem_b)
        sum_val = val_a + val_b
        quantized = fp4_quantize_value(sum_val, tensor_a.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      sum_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: sum_data,
        shape: tensor_a.shape,
        precision_mode: tensor_a.precision_mode,
        block_config: tensor_a.block_config
      }

def tensor_subtract_fp4(tensor_a: Tensor4D, tensor_b: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor_a.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem_a = get_tensor_element(tensor_a, i)
      elem_b = get_tensor_element(tensor_b, i)
      
      fork:
        val_a = dequantize_precision(elem_a)
        val_b = dequantize_precision(elem_b)
        diff_val = val_a - val_b
        quantized = fp4_quantize_value(diff_val, tensor_a.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      diff_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: diff_data,
        shape: tensor_a.shape,
        precision_mode: tensor_a.precision_mode,
        block_config: tensor_a.block_config
      }

def tensor_elementwise_multiply_fp4(tensor_a: Tensor4D, tensor_b: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor_a.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
```

## 3. HBM3e Memory Bandwidth Optimizer

```bend
// hbm3e_bandwidth_optimizer.bend
// HBM3e memória sávszélesség optimalizáló B200 GPU-hoz
// 8 TB/s bandwidth kihasználása multi-stack koordinációval
// Adaptive memory mapping és inter-stack latency redukció

type HBMStack = Stack{
  stack_id: u32,
  capacity_gb: u32,
  bandwidth_gbps: f32,
  current_utilization: f32,
  allocated_regions: Tree(MemoryRegion),
  cache_lines: Tree(CacheLine)
}

type MemoryRegion = Region{
  start_addr: u64,
  size_bytes: u64,
  tensor_id: u32,
  access_pattern: AccessPattern,
  priority: u32,
  last_access_time: u64
}

type AccessPattern = Sequential | Random | Strided{stride: u32} | Blocked{block_size: u32}

type CacheLine = Cache{
  addr: u64,
  data: List(u8),
  valid: bool,
  dirty: bool,
  lru_counter: u64
}

type MemoryCoordinator = Coordinator{
  stacks: List(HBMStack),
  total_bandwidth: f32,
  allocation_strategy: AllocationStrategy,
  request_queue: List(MemoryRequest),
  completion_queue: List(MemoryCompletion),
  outstanding_requests: u32
}

type AllocationStrategy = RoundRobin | BandwidthAware | LatencyOptimized | AdaptiveHybrid

type MemoryRequest = MemReq{
  request_id: u64,
  tensor_id: u32,
  operation: MemoryOp,
  size_bytes: u64,
  priority: u32,
  timestamp: u64
}

type MemoryOp = Read{addr: u64} | Write{addr: u64, data: List(u8)} | Prefetch{addr: u64} | Flush{addr: u64}

type MemoryCompletion = MemComp{
  request_id: u64,
  status: CompletionStatus,
  latency_cycles: u64,
  bandwidth_utilized: f32
}

type CompletionStatus = Success | Failed{error_code: u32} | Timeout

def create_hbm3e_coordinator(stack_count: u32, stack_capacity_gb: u32, stack_bandwidth_gbps: f32) -> MemoryCoordinator:
  stacks = create_hbm_stacks(stack_count, stack_capacity_gb, stack_bandwidth_gbps)
  
  total_bw = (stack_count as f32) * stack_bandwidth_gbps
  
  return Coordinator{
    stacks: stacks,
    total_bandwidth: total_bw,
    allocation_strategy: AdaptiveHybrid,
    request_queue: List/Nil,
    completion_queue: List/Nil,
    outstanding_requests: 0
  }

def create_hbm_stacks(count: u32, capacity: u32, bandwidth: f32) -> List(HBMStack):
  bend i = 0:
    when i < count:
      stack = Stack{
        stack_id: i,
        capacity_gb: capacity,
        bandwidth_gbps: bandwidth,
        current_utilization: 0.0,
        allocated_regions: Empty,
        cache_lines: Empty
      }
      
      continue with i + 1, List/Cons(stack, accumulator)
    when i >= count:
      return accumulator

def allocate_tensor_memory(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, tensor_id: u32, size_bytes: u64, access_pattern: AccessPattern) -> (MemoryCoordinator, u64):
  
  optimal_stacks = select_optimal_stacks(coordinator, size_bytes, access_pattern)
  
  bytes_per_stack = size_bytes / (List/length(optimal_stacks) as u64)
  
  fold (new_coordinator, base_addr) = (coordinator, 0) with (stack, idx) in List/enumerate(optimal_stacks):
    stack_addr = allocate_on_stack(stack, tensor_id, bytes_per_stack, access_pattern, idx)
    
    updated_coordinator = update_coordinator_stack(new_coordinator, stack.stack_id, stack_addr, bytes_per_stack)
    
    (updated_coordinator, base_addr + stack_addr)
  
  return (new_coordinator, base_addr)

def select_optimal_stacks(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, size_bytes: u64, access_pattern: AccessPattern) -> List(HBMStack):
  match coordinator.allocation_strategy:
    case RoundRobin:
      return select_round_robin(coordinator.stacks, size_bytes)
    case BandwidthAware:
      return select_bandwidth_aware(coordinator.stacks, size_bytes)
    case LatencyOptimized:
      return select_latency_optimized(coordinator.stacks, access_pattern)
    case AdaptiveHybrid:
      return select_adaptive_hybrid(coordinator.stacks, size_bytes, access_pattern)

def select_round_robin(stacks: List(HBMStack), size_bytes: u64) -> List(HBMStack):
  available_stacks = List/filter(stacks, lambda stack:
    (stack.current_utilization < 0.85) && has_capacity(stack, size_bytes)
  )
  
  return List/take(available_stacks, 4)

def select_bandwidth_aware(stacks: List(HBMStack), size_bytes: u64) -> List(HBMStack):
  sorted_stacks = List/sort_by(stacks, lambda stack: stack.current_utilization)
  
  available = List/filter(sorted_stacks, lambda stack: has_capacity(stack, size_bytes))
  
  return List/take(available, min(8, List/length(available)))

def select_latency_optimized(stacks: List(HBMStack), access_pattern: AccessPattern) -> List(HBMStack):
  match access_pattern:
    case Sequential:
      return List/filter(stacks, lambda stack: stack.stack_id < 4)
    case Random:
      return stacks
    case Strided:
      stride_optimal = List/filter(stacks, lambda stack: (stack.stack_id % 2) == 0)
      return List/take(stride_optimal, 4)
    case Blocked:
      return List/take(stacks, 8)

def select_adaptive_hybrid(stacks: List(HBMStack), size_bytes: u64, access_pattern: AccessPattern) -> List(HBMStack):
  bandwidth_weight = 0.6
  latency_weight = 0.4
  
  bandwidth_candidates = select_bandwidth_aware(stacks, size_bytes)
  latency_candidates = select_latency_optimized(stacks, access_pattern)
  
  combined = List/union(bandwidth_candidates, latency_candidates)
  
  scored_stacks = List/map(combined, lambda stack:
    (stack, compute_hybrid_score(stack, bandwidth_weight, latency_weight, size_bytes))
  )
  
  sorted_scored = List/sort_by(scored_stacks, lambda (stack, score): -score)
  
  best_stacks = List/map(List/take(sorted_scored, 8), lambda (stack, score): stack)
  
  return best_stacks

def compute_hybrid_score(stack: HBMStack, bw_weight: f32, lat_weight: f32, size_bytes: u64) -> f32:
  bandwidth_score = (1.0 - stack.current_utilization) * stack.bandwidth_gbps
  
  latency_score = estimate_access_latency(stack, size_bytes)
  
  return (bandwidth_score * bw_weight) + (latency_score * lat_weight)

def estimate_access_latency(stack: HBMStack, size_bytes: u64) -> f32:
  base_latency_ns = 100.0
  
  size_penalty = (size_bytes as f32) / (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0)
  
  utilization_penalty = stack.current_utilization * 50.0
  
  return base_latency_ns + size_penalty + utilization_penalty

def has_capacity(stack: HBMStack, required_bytes: u64) -> bool:
  capacity_bytes = (stack.capacity_gb as u64) * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
  
  allocated_bytes = Tree/fold(stack.allocated_regions, 0, lambda acc, key, region:
    acc + region.size_bytes
  )
  
  return (capacity_bytes - allocated_bytes) >= required_bytes

def allocate_on_stack(stack: HBMStack, tensor_id: u32, size_bytes: u64, access_pattern: AccessPattern, offset_idx: u32) -> u64:
  base_addr = (stack.stack_id as u64) << 40
  
  offset = (offset_idx as u64) * (128 * 1024 * 1024)
  
  return base_addr + offset

def update_coordinator_stack(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, stack_id: u32, addr: u64, size_bytes: u64) -> MemoryCoordinator:
  updated_stacks = List/map(coordinator.stacks, lambda stack:
    if stack.stack_id == stack_id:
      new_utilization = stack.current_utilization + ((size_bytes as f32) / ((stack.capacity_gb as f32) * 1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0))
      Stack{
        stack_id: stack.stack_id,
        capacity_gb: stack.capacity_gb,
        bandwidth_gbps: stack.bandwidth_gbps,
        current_utilization: new_utilization,
        allocated_regions: stack.allocated_regions,
        cache_lines: stack.cache_lines
      }
    else:
      stack
  )
  
  return Coordinator{
    stacks: updated_stacks,
    total_bandwidth: coordinator.total_bandwidth,
    allocation_strategy: coordinator.allocation_strategy,
    request_queue: coordinator.request_queue,
    completion_queue: coordinator.completion_queue,
    outstanding_requests: coordinator.outstanding_requests
  }

def prefetch_tensor_data(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, tensor_id: u32, addr: u64, size_bytes: u64) -> MemoryCoordinator:
  prefetch_size = 64 * 1024
  num_prefetch_blocks = (size_bytes / (prefetch_size as u64)) + 1
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < num_prefetch_blocks:
      prefetch_addr = addr + (i * (prefetch_size as u64))
      
      request = MemReq{
        request_id: generate_request_id(coordinator),
        tensor_id: tensor_id,
        operation: Prefetch{addr: prefetch_addr},
        size_bytes: prefetch_size as u64,
        priority: 2,
        timestamp: get_current_timestamp()
      }
      
      fork:
        enqueued_coordinator = enqueue_memory_request(coordinator, request)
        return enqueued_coordinator
      
      continue with i + 1, enqueued_coordinator
    when i >= num_prefetch_blocks:
      return coordinator

def enqueue_memory_request(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, request: MemoryRequest) -> MemoryCoordinator:
  new_queue = insert_prioritized(coordinator.request_queue, request)
  
  return Coordinator{
    stacks: coordinator.stacks,
    total_bandwidth: coordinator.total_bandwidth,
    allocation_strategy: coordinator.allocation_strategy,
    request_queue: new_queue,
    completion_queue: coordinator.completion_queue,
    outstanding_requests: coordinator.outstanding_requests + 1
  }

def insert_prioritized(queue: List(MemoryRequest), request: MemoryRequest) -> List(MemoryRequest):
  match queue:
    case List/Nil:
      return List/Cons(request, List/Nil)
    case List/Cons:
      if request.priority > queue.head.priority:
        return List/Cons(request, queue)
      else:
        return List/Cons(queue.head, insert_prioritized(queue.tail, request))

def process_memory_requests(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, max_parallel: u32) -> MemoryCoordinator:
  available_requests = List/take(coordinator.request_queue, max_parallel)
  
  fold processed_coordinator = coordinator with request in available_requests:
    completion = execute_memory_request(processed_coordinator, request)
    
    updated_queue = List/filter(processed_coordinator.request_queue, lambda r: r.request_id != request.request_id)
    updated_completions = List/Cons(completion, processed_coordinator.completion_queue)
    
    Coordinator{
      stacks: processed_coordinator.stacks,
      total_bandwidth: processed_coordinator.total_bandwidth,
      allocation_strategy: processed_coordinator.allocation_strategy,
      request_queue: updated_queue,
      completion_queue: updated_completions,
      outstanding_requests: processed_coordinator.outstanding_requests - 1
    }
  
  return processed_coordinator

def execute_memory_request(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, request: MemoryRequest) -> MemoryCompletion:
  match request.operation:
    case Read:
      latency = simulate_read_latency(coordinator, request.operation.addr, request.size_bytes)
      bandwidth = calculate_bandwidth_utilization(request.size_bytes, latency)
      
      return MemComp{
        request_id: request.request_id,
        status: Success,
        latency_cycles: latency,
        bandwidth_utilized: bandwidth
      }
    case Write:
      latency = simulate_write_latency(coordinator, request.operation.addr, request.size_bytes)
      bandwidth = calculate_bandwidth_utilization(request.size_bytes, latency)
      
      return MemComp{
        request_id: request.request_id,
        status: Success,
        latency_cycles: latency,
        bandwidth_utilized: bandwidth
      }
    case Prefetch:
      latency = simulate_prefetch_latency(coordinator, request.operation.addr, request.size_bytes)
      bandwidth = calculate_bandwidth_utilization(request.size_bytes, latency)
      
      return MemComp{
        request_id: request.request_id,
        status: Success,
        latency_cycles: latency,
        bandwidth_utilized: bandwidth
      }
    case Flush:
      return MemComp{
        request_id: request.request_id,
        status: Success,
        latency_cycles: 100,
        bandwidth_utilized: 0.0
      }

def simulate_read_latency(coordinator: MemoryCoordinator, addr: u64, size_bytes: u64) -> u64:
```

def async_pipeline_forward_pass(schedule: PipelineSchedule, nesterov_config: NesterovConfig) -> PipelineSchedule:

  fold updated_schedule = schedule with microbatch in active_microbatches:
    stage_idx = microbatch.current_stage

        updated_stage = Stage{
          stage_id: stage.stage_id,
          layer_start: stage.layer_start,
          layer_end: stage.layer_end,
          device_id: stage.device_id,
          parameters: stage.parameters,
          gradients: stage.gradients,
          activations: Tree/insert(stage.activations, microbatch.batch_id, activation),
          stage_momentum: stage.stage_momentum,
          look_ahead_params: look_ahead_params,

        }
        
        updated_microbatch = MBatch{
          batch_id: microbatch.batch_id,
          data: activation.data,
          labels: microbatch.labels,
          current_stage: microbatch.current_stage + 1,
          forward_complete: (microbatch.current_stage + 1) >= schedule.total_stages,
          backward_complete: microbatch.backward_complete
        }

        new_microbatches = List/replace(updated_schedule.microbatches, microbatch.batch_id, updated_microbatch)
        
        return Schedule{
          stages: new_stages,
          microbatches: new_microbatches,
          total_stages: updated_schedule.total_stages,

          global_step: updated_schedule.global_step,
          async_mode: updated_schedule.async_mode
        }
    else:

def compute_look_ahead_parameters(stage: PipelineStage, config: NesterovConfig) -> Tensor4D:
  momentum_contribution = tensor_scale_fp4(stage.stage_momentum, config.base_momentum)
  
  adaptive_scale = compute_adaptive_momentum_coefficient(stage, config)
  
  scaled_momentum = tensor_scale_fp4(momentum_contribution, adaptive_scale)
  
  look_ahead = tensor_add_fp4(stage.parameters, scaled_momentum)
  
  return look_ahead

def compute_adaptive_momentum_coefficient(stage: PipelineStage, config: NesterovConfig) -> f32:
  avg_staleness = compute_average_staleness(stage.staleness_tracker)
  
  staleness_ratio = (avg_staleness as f32) / (stage.staleness_tracker.max_allowed_staleness as f32)
  
  staleness_penalty = 1.0 - (staleness_ratio * config.staleness_penalty)
  
  adaptive_coeff = config.adaptive_coefficient * staleness_penalty
  
  return max(adaptive_coeff, 0.1)

def compute_average_staleness(tracker: StalenessTracker) -> u32:
  staleness_values = Tree/fold(tracker.remote_versions, List/Nil, lambda acc, key, version:
    staleness = if tracker.local_version >= version:
      tracker.local_version - version
    else:
      0
    List/Cons(staleness, acc)
  )
  
  if List/length(staleness_values) == 0:
    return 0
  
  total_staleness = List/fold(staleness_values, 0, lambda acc, s: acc + s)
  
  return total_staleness / List/length(staleness_values)

def forward_compute_stage(microbatch: MicroBatch, stage: PipelineStage, look_ahead_params: Tensor4D) -> Activation:
  hidden_output = matmul_fp4_tensor(microbatch.data, look_ahead_params)
  
  activated_output = apply_activation_function(hidden_output)
  
  return Act{
    microbatch_id: microbatch.batch_id,
    layer_id: stage.layer_start,
    data: activated_output,
    timestamp: get_current_timestamp(),
    version: stage.staleness_tracker.local_version
  }

def apply_activation_function(tensor: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem = get_tensor_element(tensor, i)
      
      fork:
        deq_val = dequantize_precision(elem)
        
        activated_val = gelu_activation(deq_val)
        
        quantized = fp4_quantize_value(activated_val, tensor.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      activated_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: activated_data,
        shape: tensor.shape,
        precision_mode: tensor.precision_mode,
        block_config: tensor.block_config
      }

def gelu_activation(x: f32) -> f32:
  sqrt_2_over_pi = 0.7978845608
  coeff = 0.044715
  
  tanh_input = sqrt_2_over_pi * (x + coeff * x * x * x)
  tanh_val = tanh(tanh_input)
  
  return 0.5 * x * (1.0 + tanh_val)

def tanh(x: f32) -> f32:
  if x > 5.0:
    return 1.0
  else if x < -5.0:
    return -1.0
  else:
    exp_2x = exp(2.0 * x)
    return (exp_2x - 1.0) / (exp_2x + 1.0)

def exp(x: f32) -> f32:
  return 2.718281828 ** x

def async_pipeline_backward_pass(schedule: PipelineSchedule, nesterov_config: NesterovConfig) -> PipelineSchedule:

    bend stage_idx = (schedule.total_stages - 1):

            global_step: updated_schedule.global_step,
            async_mode: updated_schedule.async_mode

          total_stages: updated_schedule.total_stages,
          microbatch_size: updated_schedule.microbatch_size,
          global_step: updated_schedule.global_step + 1,
          async_mode: updated_schedule.async_mode

def compute_loss_gradient(activation: Activation, labels: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  diff = tensor_subtract_fp4(activation.data, labels)
  
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = diff.shape
  scale_factor = 1.0 / ((batch * seq) as f32)
  
  scaled_gradient = tensor_scale_fp4(diff, scale_factor)
  
  return scaled_gradient

def get_upstream_gradient(schedule: PipelineSchedule, stage_idx: u32, microbatch_id: u32) -> Tensor4D:
  stage = List/get(schedule.stages, stage_idx)
  return stage.gradients

def backward_compute_stage(stage: PipelineStage, activation: Activation, upstream_gradient: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  activation_gradient = compute_activation_gradient(activation.data)
  
  local_gradient = tensor_elementwise_multiply_fp4(upstream_gradient, activation_gradient)
  
  parameter_gradient = matmul_fp4_tensor(transpose_tensor(activation.data), local_gradient)
  
  return parameter_gradient

def compute_activation_gradient(activated: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = activated.shape
  total_size = batch * seq * hidden * heads
  
  bend i = 0:
    when i < total_size:
      elem = get_tensor_element(activated, i)
      
      fork:
        deq_val = dequantize_precision(elem)
        
        grad_val = gelu_derivative(deq_val)
        
        quantized = fp4_quantize_value(grad_val, activated.block_config)
        
        return FP4Prec{val: quantized}
      
      continue with i + 1
    when i >= total_size:
      gradient_data = Tree/from_list(collect_results)
      
      return T4D{
        data: gradient_data,
        shape: activated.shape,
        precision_mode: activated.precision_mode,
        block_config: activated.block_config
      }

def gelu_derivative(x: f32) -> f32:
  sqrt_2_over_pi = 0.7978845608
  coeff = 0.044715
  
  tanh_input = sqrt_2_over_pi * (x + coeff * x * x * x)
  tanh_val = tanh(tanh_input)
  
  sech_squared = 1.0 - (tanh_val * tanh_val)
  
  tanh_derivative = sqrt_2_over_pi * (1.0 + 3.0 * coeff * x * x) * sech_squared
  
  return 0.5 * (1.0 + tanh_val) + 0.5 * x * tanh_derivative

def transpose_tensor(tensor: Tensor4D) -> Tensor4D:
  (batch, seq, hidden, heads) = tensor.shape
  
  transposed_shape = (batch, hidden, seq, heads)
  
  return T4D{
    data: tensor.data,
    shape: transposed_shape,
    precision_mode: tensor.precision_mode,
    block_config: tensor.block_config
  }

def apply_staleness_compensation(gradient: Tensor4D, stage: PipelineStage, config: NesterovConfig) -> Tensor4D:
  if !config.delay_compensation:
    return gradient
  
  staleness = compute_average_staleness(stage.staleness_tracker)
  
  if staleness == 0:
    return gradient
  
  compensation_factor = 1.0 + ((staleness as f32) * config.staleness_penalty * 0.1)
  
  compensated = tensor_scale_fp4(gradient, compensation_factor)
  
  return compensated

def update_nesterov_momentum(momentum: Tensor4D, gradient: Tensor4D, config: NesterovConfig) -> Tensor4D:
  scaled_momentum = tensor_scale_fp4(momentum, config.base_momentum)
  
  scaled_gradient = tensor_scale_fp4(gradient, 1.0 - config.base_momentum)
  
  updated_momentum = tensor_add_fp4(scaled_momentum, scaled_gradient)
  
  return updated_momentum

def increment_version(tracker: StalenessTracker) -> StalenessTracker:
  return StalTrack{
    local_version: tracker.local_version + 1,
    remote_versions: tracker.remote_versions,
    staleness_window: tracker.staleness_window,
    max_allowed_staleness: tracker.max_allowed_staleness
  }

def synchronize_stages(schedule: PipelineSchedule) -> PipelineSchedule:
  max_version = List/fold(schedule.stages, 0, lambda acc, stage:
    max(acc, stage.staleness_tracker.local_version)
  )
  
  synced_stages = List/map(schedule.stages, lambda stage:
    updated_tracker = StalTrack{
      local_version: max_version,
      remote_versions: stage.staleness_tracker.remote_versions,
      staleness_window: stage.staleness_tracker.staleness_window,
      max_allowed_staleness: stage.staleness_tracker.max_allowed_staleness
    }
    
    Stage{
      stage_id: stage.stage_id,
      layer_start: stage.layer_start,
      layer_end: stage.layer_end,
      device_id: stage.device_id,
      parameters: stage.parameters,
      gradients: stage.gradients,
      activations: stage.activations,
      stage_momentum: stage.stage_momentum,
      look_ahead_params: stage.look_ahead_params,
      staleness_tracker: updated_tracker
    }
  )
  
  return Schedule{
    stages: synced_stages,
    microbatches: schedule.microbatches,
    total_stages: schedule.total_stages,
    microbatch_size: schedule.microbatch_size,
    global_step: schedule.global_step,
    async_mode: schedule.async_mode
  }

def apply_parameter_updates(schedule: PipelineSchedule, learning_rate: f32) -> PipelineSchedule:
  updated_stages = List/map(schedule.stages, lambda stage:
    fork:
      update = tensor_scale_fp4(stage.gradients, learning_rate)
      
      new_params = tensor_subtract_fp4(stage.parameters, update)
      
      return Stage{
        stage_id: stage.stage_id,
        layer_start: stage.layer_start,
        layer_end: stage.layer_end,
        device_id: stage.device_id,
        parameters: new_params,
        gradients: stage.gradients,
        activations: stage.activations,
        stage_momentum: stage.stage_momentum,
        look_ahead_params: stage.look_ahead_params,
        staleness_tracker: stage.staleness_tracker
      }
  )
  
  return Schedule{
    stages: updated_stages,
    microbatches: schedule.microbatches,
    total_stages: schedule.total_stages,
    microbatch_size: schedule.microbatch_size,
    global_step: schedule.global_step,
    async_mode: schedule.async_mode
  }

def train_epoch_async(schedule: PipelineSchedule, nesterov_config: NesterovConfig, learning_rate: f32, num_iterations: u32) -> PipelineSchedule:
  bend iteration = 0:
    when iteration < num_iterations:
      forward_schedule = async_pipeline_forward_pass(schedule, nesterov_config)
      
      backward_schedule = async_pipeline_backward_pass(forward_schedule, nesterov_config)

            updated_schedule = apply_parameter_updates(synced_schedule, learning_rate)
            continue with iteration + 1, updated_schedule
          else:

            continue with iteration + 1, updated_schedule

            updated_schedule = apply_parameter_updates(synced_schedule, learning_rate)
            continue with iteration + 1, updated_schedule
          else:
            updated_schedule = apply_parameter_updates(backward_schedule, learning_rate)

```bend
  exp_values = List/map(tile.data, lambda x:
    exp_val = fast_exp_approximation(x - max_val)
    exp_sum = exp_sum + exp_val

    height: tile.height,

  if x < -10.0:
```

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const nccl = @import("nccl_bindings.zig");
const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;

pub const GPUCoordinator = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    world_size: usize,
    rank: usize,
    device_id: i32,
    nccl_comm: *nccl.ncclComm,
    cuda_stream: *anyopaque,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, world_size: usize, rank: usize, nccl_id: nccl.ncclUniqueId) !GPUCoordinator {
        var device_count: c_int = 0;
        var cuda_err = nccl.cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count);
        if (cuda_err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaGetDeviceCountFailed;
        }

        if (device_count < world_size) {
            std.debug.print("Error: Only {d} GPUs available, need {d}\n", .{device_count, world_size});
            return error.InsufficientGPUs;
        }

        const device_id: i32 = @intCast(rank);
        cuda_err = nccl.cudaSetDevice(device_id);
        if (cuda_err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaSetDeviceFailed;
        }

        var nccl_comm: *nccl.ncclComm = undefined;
        const nccl_err = nccl.ncclCommInitRank(&nccl_comm, @intCast(world_size), nccl_id, @intCast(rank));
        if (nccl_err != .ncclSuccess) {
            const err_str = nccl.ncclGetErrorString(nccl_err);
            std.debug.print("NCCL Error: {s}\n", .{err_str});
            return error.NCCLCommInitFailed;
        }

        var cuda_stream: *anyopaque = undefined;
        cuda_err = nccl.cudaStreamCreate(&cuda_stream);
        if (cuda_err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaStreamCreateFailed;
        }

        return GPUCoordinator{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .world_size = world_size,
            .rank = rank,
            .device_id = device_id,
            .nccl_comm = nccl_comm,
            .cuda_stream = cuda_stream,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *GPUCoordinator) void {
        _ = nccl.cudaStreamDestroy(self.cuda_stream);
        _ = nccl.ncclCommDestroy(self.nccl_comm);
    }

    pub fn allocDeviceMemory(self: *GPUCoordinator, size: usize) !*anyopaque {
        _ = self;
        var dev_ptr: ?*anyopaque = null;
        const err = nccl.cudaMalloc(&dev_ptr, size);
        if (err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaMallocFailed;
        }
        return dev_ptr.?;
    }

    pub fn freeDeviceMemory(self: *GPUCoordinator, ptr: *anyopaque) void {
        _ = self;
        _ = nccl.cudaFree(ptr);
    }

    pub fn copyHostToDevice(self: *GPUCoordinator, dst: *anyopaque, src: *const anyopaque, size: usize) !void {
        _ = self;
        const err = nccl.cudaMemcpy(dst, src, size, nccl.cudaMemcpyKind.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        if (err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaMemcpyFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn copyDeviceToHost(self: *GPUCoordinator, dst: *anyopaque, src: *const anyopaque, size: usize) !void {
        _ = self;
        const err = nccl.cudaMemcpy(dst, src, size, nccl.cudaMemcpyKind.cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
        if (err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaMemcpyFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn allReduceFloat32(self: *GPUCoordinator, send_buf: *const anyopaque, recv_buf: *anyopaque, count: usize) !void {
        const err = nccl.ncclAllReduce(
            send_buf,
            recv_buf,
            count,
            .ncclFloat32,
            .ncclSum,
            self.nccl_comm,
            self.cuda_stream
        );
        if (err != .ncclSuccess) {
            const err_str = nccl.ncclGetErrorString(err);
            std.debug.print("NCCL AllReduce Error: {s}\n", .{err_str});
            return error.NCCLAllReduceFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn allReduceFloat16(self: *GPUCoordinator, send_buf: *const anyopaque, recv_buf: *anyopaque, count: usize) !void {
        const err = nccl.ncclAllReduce(
            send_buf,
            recv_buf,
            count,
            .ncclFloat16,
            .ncclSum,
            self.nccl_comm,
            self.cuda_stream
        );
        if (err != .ncclSuccess) {
            const err_str = nccl.ncclGetErrorString(err);
            std.debug.print("NCCL AllReduce (f16) Error: {s}\n", .{err_str});
            return error.NCCLAllReduceFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn broadcastFloat32(self: *GPUCoordinator, buf: *anyopaque, count: usize, root: usize) !void {
        const err = nccl.ncclBroadcast(
            buf,
            buf,
            count,
            .ncclFloat32,
            @intCast(root),
            self.nccl_comm,
            self.cuda_stream
        );
        if (err != .ncclSuccess) {
            return error.NCCLBroadcastFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn synchronize(self: *GPUCoordinator) !void {
        const err = nccl.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.cuda_stream);
        if (err != .cudaSuccess) {
            return error.CudaSynchronizeFailed;
        }
    }

    pub fn barrier(self: *GPUCoordinator) !void {
        var sync_value: f32 = 0.0;
        const sync_buffer = try self.allocDeviceMemory(@sizeOf(f32));
        defer self.freeDeviceMemory(sync_buffer);

        try self.copyHostToDevice(sync_buffer, &sync_value, @sizeOf(f32));
        try self.allReduceFloat32(sync_buffer, sync_buffer, 1);
        try self.synchronize();
    }

    pub fn isRoot(self: *const GPUCoordinator) bool {
        return self.rank == 0;
    }
};
```
